local_changes: ax.cpp includes the private borrowed-RAM/ARAM shim instead of upstream runtime.h
only measured newer GameCube AX hash 07f88145 is enabled by the adapter
channel-enable and volume-ramp bits adapted for newer AX protocol
voice parameter-block core remains 93 halfwords; game 0xEC stride comes from linked-list addresses; tail preserved
strict command-list word bounds, terminator and linked-list budgets; no upstream size+64 overread
compressor and other approximations explicitly reported as partial limitations

src_type 0 uses a 4-tap, 128-phase polyphase interpolator with generated (windowed-sinc) coefficients per coef_select instead of linear interpolation; DSP coefficient ROM values are not used and the approximation remains flagged
SRC advances phase/input before interpolating; no-SRC consumes exactly one input per output independently of ratio; chronological history is preserved across millisecond segments
wide interpolation products avoid signed overflow on full-range sample transitions; phase accumulation preserves 16.16 carry
enabled mixer routes write their final signed contribution to the corresponding PB depop field; disabled/stopped routes retain history
excluded: dsp_hle.cpp heuristic AX selection and incomplete task-upload parser
reference_only: Dolphin GPL sources were consulted for hash classification and hardware field meanings; no Dolphin implementation was transplanted. See port/analysis/upstream-audio.md.
